Marks **Global**, and a **repo** label when it can be inferred.
- **"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"Skills**: session-only checks. A skill appends `/skill-name` to the composer; a fully checked repo w"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"rites `/repo` and expands on send. Hiding and reopening the tab clears this session's checks.
- **Au"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"to-start**: persistent defaults, injected once on the first message of each session. Same grouping a"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"nd checkboxes as Skills.
- Sort: **Repo** (default) / **Name** / **Most used** / **Source**. Repo an"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"d Source views fold by group.
- **Guard** (off by default): when on, model `skill` tool calls outsid"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"e Auto-start ∪ this session's picks are rejected. Typed `/skill` is never blocked.
- Uses frontmatte"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"r `description` when present; otherwise generates one English line and caches it. Never writes skill"},{"id":"p6s9","text":" files.
- Also lists Codex / Grok / Hermes user skills (builtins skipped). Duplicates across agents "},{"id":"p6s10","text":"are listed separately. Checks write `/name@agent`; the plugin injects that source's `SKILL.md`. Thes"},{"id":"p6s11","text":"e are **not** registered in the model's `available_skills`.
- **Update** runs `git pull` on git-back"},{"id":"p6s12","text":"ed skills and re-fetches skills with a per-skill origin marker. Root-level markers and skills with n"},{"id":"p6s13","text":"o source are skipped.
